<h2>Validate Allowed Configuration Values</h2>

<h3>Description</h3>

<p>Validates a non-empty, unique character vector against supported values.
</p>


<h3>Usage</h3>

<pre><code class='language-R'>validate_config_allowed_values(vec_values, argument_name, vec_supported_values)
</code></pre>


<h3>Arguments</h3>

<table role = "presentation">
<tr><td><code id="vec_values">vec_values</code></td>
<td>
<p>Character vector supplied by a configuration caller.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="argument_name">argument_name</code></td>
<td>
<p>Single character string naming the validated argument.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="vec_supported_values">vec_supported_values</code></td>
<td>
<p>Non-empty character vector of supported values.</p>
</td></tr>
</table>


<h3>Value</h3>

<p>'NULL', invisibly. The function aborts when validation fails.
</p>
